ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast ratio; approximately 40:60 distribution of high-intensity white (RGB values >220) to low-intensity black (RGB values <40) across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Centralized high-intensity white contiguous regions on both lobes. Left lobe features heavy black mottling and dendritic 'splatter' patterns within the white area. Right lobe contains a larger, more solid white geometric area in the medial section, tapering into solid black toward the distal tip and trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped central depression; calculated interior angle approximately 45 degrees; notch depth is roughly 10% of the total fluke height at the midline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations detected across the entire trailing edge boundary. Left lobe shows deeper, more jagged indentations compared to the more finely serrated right lobe trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing edge, tapering to sharp, pointed distal tips. The trajectory is asymmetrical, with the left lobe appearing slightly more rounded than the right.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct cluster of high-contrast, multi-tonal (white/beige) circular calcified structures on the extreme distal tip of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple low-intensity (black) linear pixel disruptions cutting vertically through the white pigmentation regions on both lobes, most concentrated in the medial region of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent barnacle colony on the left distal tip; irregular notches and small tissue voids along the trailing edge boundary of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'splatter' pigmentation where high-density black pixel clusters are isolated within the large white interior regions.
